en.headline: Hiker airlifted after falling ill on Sai Kung trail
en.dek: A man among a group of eight collapsed near Cheung Sheung on MacLehose Trail Section 2; Government Flying Service helicopters lifted him to hospital conscious.

zh.headline: 西貢吹筒坳行山客不適 直升機救起送院
zh.dek: 一名男子在麥理浩徑第二段吹筒坳附近與同行七人行山時暈倒，政府飛行服務隊直升機將他清醒送往東區醫院。

en.headline: Man charged over pinhole cameras in Sha Tin gym granted bail
en.dek: Fung Kwok-wang, 34, faces a voyeurism count after three devices were found in changing rooms at a 24/7 Fitness branch; the case was adjourned to 25 November.

zh.headline: 沙田健身室針孔鏡頭案 34歲地盤管工准保釋
zh.dek: 馮國浤被控窺淫罪，沙田裁判法院批准以2,000元現金保釋，案件押後至11月25日再訊。

en.headline: Hospital Authority offers 2,200 posts to new nursing graduates
en.dek: The authority said it received about 3,000 applications in the first round of recruitment completed in June and is preparing a second round open to experienced nurses as well.

zh.headline: 醫管局首輪招聘應屆護士批出約2200份聘書
zh.dek: 醫管局六月完成首輪招聘，收到約3000宗申請，正準備第二輪招聘，亦開放予有經驗護士。

en.headline: Lee urges media to tell good stories of Hong Kong and nation
en.dek: At a National Day reception for the press, the Chief Executive said the government would keep helping local outlets expand their international reach.

zh.headline: 李家超籲新聞界客觀報道 擔當國家及香港好故事發聲人
zh.dek: 行政長官出席新聞界國慶活動，表示政府會繼續協助本地傳媒提升競爭力及國際傳播力。

en.headline: Pianist John Lee to play City Hall in Hong Kong Artists series
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said tickets at HK$220 are on sale for the 8pm recital on 27 October at the City Hall Theatre.

zh.headline: 康文署香港藝術家系列十月呈獻李子朗鋼琴演奏會
zh.dek: 李子朗10月27日晚上8時於大會堂劇院演出，票價220元，現已於城市售票網發售。

en.headline: Bangkok floods delay at least 21 Hong Kong flights
en.dek: Airport data cited by the South China Morning Post showed ten inbound and four outbound Hong Kong–Bangkok services delayed by an hour or more on Sunday.

zh.headline: 曼谷水浸影響往來香港航班至少二十一班延誤
zh.dek: 傳媒引述機場資料，週日至少十班抵港及四班離港曼谷航班延誤一小時或以上，其中一班近二十四小時。

en.headline: HSBC completes US$1 billion share buyback programme
en.dek: The bank said a final Hong Kong purchase of 911,200 shares on Monday brought the programme announced on 5 August to a close.

zh.headline: 滙控完成十億美元股份回購計劃
zh.dek: 滙豐控股公布周一在港再購入91.12萬股註銷後，8月5日宣布的十億美元回購已完成。

en.headline: Fortune-telling stall at Wong Tai Sin Temple burgled
en.dek: A lock was forced overnight and about HK$4,000 in cash was taken from a stall beside the temple, police and local reports said.

zh.headline: 黃大仙祠解籤檔遭爆竊 失約四千元
zh.dek: 解籤檔匙膽被撬，檔主周二早上開舖發現櫃筒被翻，失港幣三千多元及人民幣七百多元。

en.headline: Seven hurt after minibus and van collide in Sha Tin
en.dek: A green minibus driver and six passengers were injured when the vehicle struck a van on Sha Tin Rural Committee Road at 9.13am on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 沙田鄉事會路小巴客貨車相撞 七人受傷
zh.dek: 一輛專線小巴周二上午9時13分在沙田鄉事會路與客貨車相撞，小巴司機及六名乘客受傷，原因待查。

en.headline: LANY plays AsiaWorld-Expo on Wednesday in Soft World Tour
en.dek: The Los Angeles duo's standing-only show at Hall 10 starts at 8pm, with general tickets from HK$699 according to promoter Live Nation.

zh.headline: LANY周三亞博館舉行Soft World巡演香港站
zh.dek: 洛杉磯二人組合周三晚8時於亞洲國際博覽館10號展館演出，主辦稱全場企位，一般門票由699元起。

en.headline: Man injured in Tsim Sha Tsui bottle attack; two men taken in
en.dek: A middle-aged man was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital after being struck on the head outside a bar on Minden Avenue early Tuesday.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀棉登徑男子遭玻璃樽襲擊 兩人被帶走
zh.dek: 約50歲男子周二凌晨在樓上酒吧外頭部受傷，清醒送伊利沙伯醫院，警方其後截查七人車。

en.headline: Average wages rise 3.4 percent in June, Census says
en.dek: Real wages were up 1.6 percent after inflation, and payroll per person engaged climbed 3.5 percent in the second quarter.

zh.headline: 統計處：6月平均工資率按年升3.4%
zh.dek: 扣除通脺後實質工資升1.6%；第二季從業員平均薪金名義升3.5%、實質升1.6%。

en.headline: Government sets 420,000-unit housing target for next decade
en.dek: The Long Term Housing Strategy update keeps the 70:30 public-private split and pledges more than 35,000 public units a year from 2027-28.

zh.headline: 長策周年報告訂下個十年供應目標42萬伙
zh.dek: 房屋局維持公私營七三比，並爭取2027/28起五年平均每年提供逾3.5萬個公營單位。

en.headline: Very hot weather warning remains in force as city stays fine
en.dek: The Observatory says urban areas will reach about 33 degrees, with the New Territories a couple of degrees hotter, under mainly fine skies.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告持續生效 天文台料市區最高約33度
zh.dek: 天文台上午6時45分發出警告，預期今日大致天晴，日間酷熱，新界氣溫較市區再高一兩度。

en.headline: National Day half-price cinema tickets go on sale at 52 theatres
en.dek: The Hong Kong Theatres Association scheme cuts all regular ticket types on 1 October, with sales having opened at noon on Monday.

zh.headline: 國慶「10.1半價睇好戲」52間戲院門票開售
zh.dek: 香港戲院商會活動於周一中午起售10月1日半價戲票，涵蓋一般票種及部分特殊影院格式。

en.headline: North Kwai Chung clinic to offer evening sessions five nights a week
en.dek: From 2 October the temporarily relocated family medicine clinic will extend night clinics from Wednesday and Thursday only to Monday through Friday.

zh.headline: 北葵涌家庭醫學診所10月2日起夜診增至五晚
zh.dek: 暫遷至下葵涌分科診所的北葵涌家庭醫學診所，夜診將由每周兩晚增至周一至周五。

en.headline: Hong Kong team takes record 15 awards at WorldSkills Shanghai
en.dek: MTR technician Tang Kwong-tai won silver in railway vehicle technology as the 41-member team finished with one silver and 14 medallions of excellence.

zh.headline: 世界技能大賽港隊奢15獎創歷屆新高
zh.dek: 港鐵技術員鄧光大在軌道車輛技術項目奪銀並獲選最佳選手，港隊另添14個優異獎章。

en.headline: Private home prices edge up 0.06 percent in August
en.dek: The Rating and Valuation Department’s overall price index rose to 320.5, while the rental index climbed 1.64 percent to a record 210.3.

zh.headline: 8月私宅售價指數微升0.06% 租金指數再創新高
zh.dek: 差餘物業估價署公布8月整體售價指數報320.5，按年升10.98%；租金指數升1.64%至210.3，連升10個月。

en.headline: Hong Kong and Guangdong sign yacht travel work arrangements
en.dek: The Marine Department and the Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration signed papers covering Guangdong yachts entering Hong Kong waters and Hong Kong yachts sailing north, with southbound details still to come.

zh.headline: 港粵簽署遊艇互訪工作安排 粵艇南下進入最後準備
zh.dek: 海事處與廣東海事局周一簽署「粵艇南下」及「港艇北上」工作安排，當局稱稍後公布廣東籍遊艇訪港實施細節。

en.headline: Hong Kong gold clearing company names first chief executive
en.dek: Chan Ping-keung will take up a three-year term on 2 October at the government-owned firm building a central gold clearing system due to open in the first quarter of 2027.

zh.headline: 港金結算公司任命陳秉强為首任行政總裁
zh.dek: 前港交所高層陳秉强將於10月2日履新，任期三年，負責籌備明年首季啟用的黃金中央清算及結算系統。

en.headline: Immersive space exhibition Fly Me to the Moon opens at K11 MUSEA from 2 October
en.dek: The multi-sensory show invites visitors on a 380,000-kilometre journey to the moon with panoramic projections, lunar habitat designs and outdoor installations along Victoria Harbour.

zh.headline: 沉浸式太空展「飛奔到月球」10月2日起於K11 MUSEA開幕
zh.dek: 展覽帶領觀眾踏上38萬公里月球之旅，結合全景投影、月球居住艙設計及維港海旁戶外裝置，啟發對未來生活的想像。

en.headline: Transport Department to accept autonomous vehicle commercial applications this year
en.dek: Commissioner Winnie Tse said the department will open applications for individual AV projects after successful driverless trials at the airport and Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge port.

zh.headline: 運輸署今年內接受自動車商業化營運申請
zh.dek: 署長謝詠誼表示，機場島及港珠澳大橋香港口岸無人駕駛測試成功後，署方將開始接受個別項目的商業化申請。

en.headline: Checkpoints expected to handle 7.44 million trips over Golden Week
en.dek: Immigration Department forecasts peak outbound land traffic on 3 October and peak inbound on 4 October, with Lo Wu, Lok Ma Chau Spur Line and Shenzhen Bay busiest.

zh.headline: 國慶黃金周料744萬人次進出香港
zh.dek: 入境處預計陸路出境高峰為10月3日、入境高峰為10月4日，羅湖、落馬洲支線及深圳灣最繁忙。

en.headline: Police to hold highest-honour funeral for PC Jacky Chu on 22 October
en.dek: The officer, who was left paralysed after a 2005 knife attack while on duty, will be buried at Gallant Garden the following day.

zh.headline: 警方10月22日為警員朱振國舉行最高榮譽葬禮
zh.dek: 2005年執勤遇襲癱瘓21年的警員朱振國，將於翌日安葬浩園。

en.headline: Kai Tak Hospital begins phased opening from 5 October
en.dek: The Family Medicine Integrated Centre will open first, with specialist outpatient and oncology services transferring from Queen Elizabeth Hospital in stages.

zh.headline: 啟德醫院10月5日起分階段投入服務
zh.dek: 家庭醫學綜合中心率先開診，專科門診及腫瘤科服務將由伊利沙伯醫院分批轉移。

en.headline: DoJ launches one-month consultation on Arbitration Ordinance amendments
en.dek: The Department of Justice is seeking stakeholder views until 27 October on proposed changes aimed at reinforcing Hong Kong’s position as an international arbitration hub.

zh.headline: 律政司就《仲裁條例》修訂展開一個月諮詢
zh.dek: 諮詢期至10月27日，涵蓋加快程序、保密、適用範圍及公平等四大範疇，目標明年提交條例草案。

en.headline: Phased road closures set for National Day fireworks on Thursday
en.dek: Police will shut major roads on both sides of Victoria Harbour from Thursday afternoon for the 23-minute display expected to draw about 260,000 spectators.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花匯演周四晚舉行 維港兩岸分階段封路
zh.dek: 煙花約晚上8時開始、歷時23分鐘，預計吸引約26萬人觀賞，警方下午5時起在九龍及港島實施分階段封路。

en.headline: Man found dead in Tuen Mun drainage facility near Siu Hong
en.dek: Rescuers recovered a man from a low-flow interception system on Siu Hong Road after drainage staff raised the alarm; he was certified dead at the scene.

zh.headline: 屯門兆康路渠務設施發現男子遺體
zh.dek: 渠務人員下午發現低流量截流系統內有人被困，救援人員救出男子後證實死亡，警方封鎖現場調查。

en.headline: HKTDC lifts 2026 export growth forecast to 42-47 percent on AI demand
en.dek: The Trade Development Council said stronger-than-expected global appetite for semiconductors and electronics pushed first-eight-month growth to 42.5 percent.

zh.headline: 貿發局上調今年出口增長預測至42%至47%
zh.dek: 受人工智能相關電子產品需求帶動，首八個月出口按年升42.5%，貿發局將全年預測大幅上調。

en.headline: Four women arrested for offering makeup and tour services on visitor visas
en.dek: Immigration officers say the suspects, aged 20 to 31, advertised one-stop photography, styling and guide packages on social media and were caught while providing the services.

zh.headline: 入境處拘四名訪客女子涉提供化妝拍攝導遊服務
zh.dek: 四名20至31歲女子以訪客身份來港，涉嫌在社交平台招徠一條龍化妝、攝影及導遊服務，被控違反逗留條件。

en.headline: Customs seizes 400 suspected poisonous slimming injections from Japan
en.dek: Two local residents were arrested and released on bail after officers found anti-obesity vials valued at about HK$290,000 in a postal packet at the Air Mail Centre.

zh.headline: 海關檢獲400支疑來自日本有毒減肥針劑 拘兩人
zh.dek: 海關在空郵中心截獲懷疑含第一部毒藥的減肥注射劑，市值約29萬元，兩名本地居民被捕後獲准保釋。

en.headline: HKEX opens photo exhibition marking 40 years at Exchange Square
en.dek: The four-week free display at the Rotunda traces Hong Kong’s modern stock exchange history through rare images, footage and artefacts, opening to the public from Monday afternoon.

zh.headline: 港交所展開交易廣場40周年圖片展
zh.dek: 為期四周的免費展覽於交易廣場圓形大廳展出珍罕照片、影像及文物，追溯香港現代證券交易所發展，周一下午起向公眾開放。

en.headline: Marine Department probes yacht that sped at rowers near High Island
en.dek: A rower in Saturday’s Sai Kung Coastal Challenge said a yacht accelerated towards his boat in a deliberate act; the department will investigate even without a formal report.

zh.headline: 西貢破邊洲附近遊艇高速逼近划艇 海事處主動調查
zh.dek: 周六西貢海岸挑戰賽期間，一名划艇手指遊艇刻意加速直衝其船，海事處周一表示即使未接獲舉報亦會主動調查。

en.headline: Very hot weather warning issued as temperatures climb
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the warning at 11:15 am, advising the public to guard against heat stroke while the city remains mainly fine and very hot.

zh.headline: 天文台發出酷熱天氣警告
zh.dek: 天文台上午11時15分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日天氣酷熱，市民應慎防中暑。

en.headline: Cathay extends Dubai and Riyadh flight suspension to end of January
en.dek: Passenger services to the two Middle East cities remain cancelled through 31 January 2027 as the carrier continues to monitor the regional situation.

zh.headline: 國泰延長迪拜及利雅得航班停飛至明年1月底
zh.dek: 國泰航空周一宣布，往返阿聯酋迪拜及沙特利雅得的客運航班繼續取消至2027年1月31日，並會繼續密切留意中東局勢。

en.headline: Jason Poon and wife granted bail over alleged HK$6m loan fraud
en.dek: The construction businessman and his wife face fraud and money-laundering charges linked to a Covid-era SME financing scheme; the case will move to the District Court.

zh.headline: 潘焯鴻夫婦涉600萬元貸款詐騙獲保釋
zh.dek: 建築商人潘焯鴻及妻子被控涉及疫情期間中小企融資擔保計劃詐騙及洗黑錢，案件將轉介區域法院審理。

en.headline: Nearly 440,000 mainland arrivals over Mid-Autumn weekend
en.dek: Immigration figures show 439,532 trips by mainland visitors from Friday to Sunday, with hotels expecting occupancy above 90 per cent for the coming National Day holiday.

zh.headline: 中秋周末近44萬人次內地客訪港
zh.dek: 入境處周一公布，上周五至日錄得439,532人次內地旅客抵港，佔期間總入境約四分一；旅遊業界預料黃金周熱門區酒店入住率逾九成。

en.headline: Hong Kong claim esports bronze in Honor of Kings at Asian Games
en.dek: The SAR team lost in the semifinals to Malaysia and share third place with the Philippines under the no-bronze-match format.

zh.headline: 亞運電競王者榮耀港隊摘銅
zh.dek: 港隊準決賽不敵馬來西亞，賽制不設銅牌戰，與菲律賓並列第三，為今屆第二面電競獎牌。

en.headline: Jury discharged in Abby Choi murder trial after juror withdraws
en.dek: Deputy Judge Brian Keith ordered a fresh panel to be selected on Wednesday after one of nine jurors cited health concerns.

zh.headline: 蔡天鳳謀殺案陪審員因健康退出 法官解散陪審團周三重選
zh.dek: 高等法院副法官祈彥輝接納一名陪審員健康理由申請，原定今日開案陳詞押後，周三重新抽選陪審團。

en.headline: Hong Kong to pulp all recovered waste paper locally from 1 October
en.dek: The EcoPark facility in Tuen Mun will handle the city’s full volume, expanding accepted types beyond cardboard, newspapers and office paper to include mixed paper.

zh.headline: 回收廢紙10月1日起全面本地製漿
zh.dek: 屯門環保園設施處理全港廢紙，可回收種類擴至紙袋、包裝盒及包裝紙，推動循環經濟。

en.headline: Yellow work heat stress warning in force from late morning
en.dek: The Labour Department issued the yellow warning at 11:20 am, advising employers to take heat precautions for outdoor and non-air-conditioned indoor work.

zh.headline: 黃色工作暑熱警告上午11時20分生效
zh.dek: 勞工處表示部分工作環境熱壓力頗高，僱主應採取防暑措施，包括重新編排工作及提供適當休息。

en.headline: Half of Po Pin Chau Mid-Autumn bookings did not show, AFCD says
en.dek: An average of 2,360 people reserved the Sai Kung trail each day from 25 to 27 September, but only about 1,170 arrived. A lawmaker urged fees or deposits.

zh.headline: 破邊洲中秋周末近半預約未到訪 方國珊倡收費或按金
zh.dek: 漁護署指9月25至27日日均2360人預約、實際到訪約1170人；議員建議開放候補名額並考慮收費。

en.headline: Travel council says Mid-Autumn visitor numbers encouraging ahead of Golden Week
en.dek: TIC chairman Tam Kwong-shun said hotels for 1 to 3 October are nearly full and more than half of National Day visitors are expected to stay overnight.

zh.headline: 旅議會：中秋訪港內地客令人鼓舞 國慶酒店近滿
zh.dek: 主席譚光舜表示，10月1至3日酒店已接近預訂爆滿，估計黃金周過夜旅客佔五成多。

en.headline: Eighteen lightly hurt after minibus hits works vehicle on Fanling Highway
en.dek: The Transport Department closed Kowloon-bound lanes near Choi Yuen Estate after a morning collision; the minibus driver was trapped and later freed.

zh.headline: 粉嶺公路小巴撼工程車 18人輕傷 往九龍方向一度全線封閉
zh.dek: 今早近九時上水彩園邨對開發生車禍，專線小巴司機一度被困，運輸署封閉粉嶺公路往九龍方向近彩園邨全線。

en.headline: Wan Chai grill pop-up Marrow ends its run on Wednesday
en.dek: Chef Chris Ma’s meat-led pop-up at Lee Tung Avenue serves its last dinners on 30 September before the site returns to its usual occupant.

zh.headline: 灣仔利東街扒房快閃店Marrow周三結束
zh.dek: 主廚馬桂煄的肉類主題快閃店Marrow將於9月30日在利東街供應最後一晚晚餐。

en.headline: Wong Tai Sin Temple lanterns stay lit through 4 October
en.dek: Sik Sik Yuen is keeping Mid-Autumn lanterns and late opening at Wong Tai Sin Temple through the National Day holiday week, with free admission.

zh.headline: 黃大仙祠中秋綵燈展至10月4日
zh.dek: 嗤色園黃大仙祠中秋綵燈及夜間延長開放安排持續至10月4日，國慶假期期間仍可免費入場。

en.headline: PBOC issues RMB 60 billion of six-month bills in Hong Kong
en.dek: The People's Bank of China dated a new batch of central bank bills for Monday after a tender last week that drew more than twice the amount on offer.

zh.headline: 人民銀行在港發行600億元人民幣半年期票據
zh.dek: 中國人民銀行一筆600億元人民幣半年期央行票據今日在港發行，上周招標超額認購逾一倍。

en.headline: Victoria Park lantern displays stay up until 4 October
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department has extended the Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival by a week after large crowds during the festival.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈展延長至10月4日
zh.dek: 康文署因應人流眾多，把維多利亞公園中秋綵燈嘉年華延長一周至10月4日。

en.headline: Clinics face March deadline to use listed injectable devices
en.dek: Licensed private healthcare facilities must use only MDACS-listed injectable and infusible medical devices from 1 March 2027, the Department of Health said.

zh.headline: 私營醫療機構明年三月起須用表列注射器械
zh.dek: 衞生署規定，持牌私營醫療機構由2027年3月1日起，只可使用已在醫療器械行政管理制度表列的注射及輸注醫療器械。

en.headline: Greater Bay Airlines opens first Indonesia route to Surabaya
en.dek: The carrier flew its inaugural Hong Kong–Surabaya service on Friday and plans up to four flights a week on the new link.

zh.headline: 大灣區航空開通首條印尼航線 直飛泗水
zh.dek: 大灣區航空周五開辦香港至泗水定期航班，計劃每周最多四班，屬該公司首條印尼航線。

en.headline: Disgusting Food Museum opens at AIRSIDE Kai Tak on Tuesday
en.dek: The Swedish exhibition of more than 80 polarising dishes from 35 countries runs from 29 September to 26 November, complete with a tasting bar and a free vomit bag for every visitor.

zh.headline: 「嘔心食物博物館」周二啟德AIRSIDE開幕
zh.dek: 瑞典展覽匯集35個國家逾80款爭議美食，展期至11月26日，設試食吧，每位入場者獲贈特製嘔吐袋。

en.headline: Sun Dong sets June deadline for Hetao cross-border talent flow
en.dek: The technology minister said free movement of people in the innovation hub must begin by 30 June next year at the latest, following data-flow pledges.

zh.headline: 孫東：河套跨境人才流動最遲明年6月底啟動
zh.dek: 創科局局長表示，河套合作區人員流動必須最遲於明年6月30日前展開，數據流動亦希望盡快試行。

en.headline: Buyers snap up nearly 300 new flats ahead of expected rate rises
en.dek: Developers sold out all units launched over the weekend as home-seekers moved to lock in mortgages before local rates climb, agents said.

zh.headline: 買家趕在加息前入市 周末近300個新盤單位售罄
zh.dek: 發展商周末推售超過290個單位全部售出，代理指買家希望在本地息口上升前鎖定按揭。

en.headline: Police hunt man who stole HK$10,000 from claw machines with a key
en.dek: A man in his thirties opened deposit boxes at four machines in a Tai Kok Tsui shop on Sunday morning and fled with the cash, police said.

zh.headline: 大角咀夾公仔機被用鎖匙盜走約一萬元 警方追緝男子
zh.dek: 店主周日上午透過閉路電視錄影片段，目睹一名男子打開四部機的投幣箱取走現金後離開。

en.headline: Housing chief trials water-tank cleaning robot in three estates
en.dek: The locally developed amphibious robot has been tested at Mun Tung, Hoi Ying and Lai Yiu estates and is expected to enter mass production this year.

zh.headline: 洗水缸機械人三屋邨試用 何永賢冀今年量產
zh.dek: 本地研發第四代兩棲機械人已於滿東邨、海盈邨及麗瑤邨試用，可遙控操作減少密閉空間風險。

en.headline: Seven-year-old girl hurt by falling wood at Choi Wan Estate
en.dek: A circular wooden piece about five inches across struck the child outside Koon Yat House on Sunday afternoon; she was treated on site and declined hospital admission.

zh.headline: 彩雲邨觀日樓木塊墮下擊傷7歲女童
zh.dek: 周日下午約5時直徑約5吋圓形木塊從高處墮下，女童手部受傷，治理後拒絕送院。

en.headline: Police arrest 34-year-old man over pinhole cameras in Sha Tin gym
en.dek: Three suspected hidden cameras were found in changing rooms at a 24/7 Fitness branch on Lek Yuen Street; the local man remains in custody.

zh.headline: 沙田健身室更衣室藏針孔鏡頭 34歲男涉窺淫被捕
zh.dek: 24/7 Fitness瀝源街分店三間更衣室發現懷疑偷拍裝置，本地男子周日在沙田區落網，現正扣查。

en.headline: Chan says August exports up 53 percent on AI demand, GDP goal in reach
en.dek: The Financial Secretary wrote that overall merchandise exports reached HK$667.9 billion last month and the government remains confident of 3.5 to 4.5 percent growth for the year.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：8月出口升53% AI需求帶動 有信心達GDP目標
zh.dek: 財政司長在網誌指整體商品出口貨值達6,679億元，首八個月升42.5%，政府有信心全年經濟增長3.5%至4.5%。

en.headline: Three hikers fall ill on trails as temperatures hit 33C
en.dek: Two men suffered suspected heatstroke on the Po Pin Chau route in Sai Kung and a third developed dizziness; a government helicopter airlifted one patient to hospital.

zh.headline: 氣溫高見33度 三名行山人士不適 破邊洲兩男疑中暑
zh.dek: 西貢破邊洲上午至中午接連兩宗疑中暑個案，其中一人由飛行服務隊直升機送院；另有一名行山人士感暈眩。

en.headline: Forty percent of pedestrian crossings now have new audible devices
en.dek: The Transport Department has upgraded more than 800 junctions and expects to finish the citywide programme of about 2,000 sites by the end of 2027.

zh.headline: 全港四成行人過路處已換新一代發聲裝置
zh.dek: 運輸署稱進度理想，預期2027年底前完成約2,000個路口更換，優先深水埗及觀塘。

en.headline: Hong Kong thrash Laos 4-0 in FIFA ASEAN Cup opener at Kai Tak
en.dek: Sun Ming-him, Everton Camargo, Dudu and Matt Orr scored as nearly 19,000 fans watched the hosts take control of Group A on Sunday afternoon.

zh.headline: 東盟盃港隊4:0大勝老撾 啟德近1.9萬人見證
zh.dek: 孫銘謙、艾華頓、杜度及安永佳各建一功，港隊在A組暫列榜首，羅淑佩讚戰果具說服力。

en.headline: Law outlines Victoria Park tennis redevelopment with retractable roof
en.dek: The sports minister said Hong Kong Stadium could host interim tournaments and the project would try to spare the swimming pool and hard courts.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩：維園網球場擬建開合式上蓋 過渡期用大球場
zh.dek: 文體旅局長指目標達ATP 500或更高標準，重建盡量避開泳池及硬地足球場。

en.headline: Hong Kong men's epee team takes Asian Games bronze
en.dek: The side reached the semi-finals before losing to world champions Kazakhstan, securing a medal without a bronze-medal match.

zh.headline: 亞運男子重劍團體港隊奪銅
zh.dek: 港隊晉級四強後不敵世界冠軍哈薩克，因不設季軍賽而鎖定銅牌。

en.headline: Lee Ka-yi and Tang Ming-hong win Asian Games squash mixed doubles gold
en.dek: Hong Kong claimed gold and silver in the event after an all-SAR final at the Nagoya Kinjo Futo Arena on Sunday.

zh.headline: 亞運壁球混雙港隊包辦金銀 李嘉兒鄧銘漮奪金
zh.dek: 港隊兩對組合於名古屋決賽對壘，李嘉兒及鄧銘漮組合奪得金牌，港隊歷史性包辦金銀牌。

en.headline: Work-week outlook: mainly fine and very hot through midweek
en.dek: The Observatory expects an anticyclone aloft to keep Hong Kong sunny and very hot early in the week before a northeast monsoon brings more cloud and showers later.

zh.headline: 未來一週天氣展望：初段大致天晴酷熱 後期雲量增多
zh.dek: 天文台預料高空反氣旋令本週初香港大致天晴及酷熱，東北季候風將於週後期影響華南，雲量增多並有幾陣驟雨。

en.headline: Autumn travel expo at Wan Chai convention centre ends Sunday
en.dek: The three-day Hong Kong Holiday and Travel Expo in Hall 5BCD runs until 8pm, with a $30 ticket and a 3pm mascot parade.

zh.headline: 灣仔會展秋季旅遊博覽會周日閉幕
zh.dek: 香港秋季旅遊博覽會在會展展覽館5BCD舉行至晚上8時，門票30元，下午3時有吉祥物巡遊。

en.headline: Sun Dong says market partners will speed San Tin site formation
en.dek: The innovation chief said two to three hectares at San Tin Technopole could be released from late this year, ahead of the original post-2030 timetable.

zh.headline: 孫東：用市場力量提前平整新田科技城用地
zh.dek: 創科及工業局局長稱會提早推進一級土地開發，預料年底至明年初率先釋出兩至三公頃，較原定2030年後產出為早。

en.headline: Lo says Hospital Authority still has 3,200 nurse vacancies
en.dek: The health chief again rejected claims that local graduates cannot find work, saying about 99 percent of registered-nurse applicants were hired.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：醫管局仍有約3200個護士空缺
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長再指「畢業就失業」說法不成立，註冊護士申請獲聘近99%；非本地培訓護士佔公院不足0.2%。

en.headline: Woman, 89, dies after morning swim at Tsuen Wan Approach Beach
en.dek: Firefighters pulled the unconscious swimmer from the water off Ting Kau shortly after 5am; she was certified dead at Yan Chai Hospital.

zh.headline: 荃灣近水灣泳灘89歲婦人早泳遇溺不治
zh.dek: 消防今早約5時18分後在汀九近水灣救起昏迷泳客，送往仁濟醫院後證實死亡，警方列遇溺調查。

en.headline: Kai Tak water festival and dragon boat races run through Sunday
en.dek: The second HEY! Water Festival continues at Runway 1331 on the former airport strip, with a full day of racing after Saturday's opening.

zh.headline: 啟德Hey水節及龍舟賽週日續舉行
zh.dek: 第二屆香港Hey水節連同連城龍舟賽在啟航1331進行至今日，周六已有逾800名健兒參賽。

en.headline: Hong Kong face Laos at Kai Tak in FIFA ASEAN Cup
en.dek: The hosts open their Division 2 campaign at 3pm, with Cambodia versus Myanmar to follow at 6pm at Kai Tak Stadium.

zh.headline: 東盟盃港隊主場啟德迎戰老撾 下午三時開波
zh.dek: 國際足協東盟盃分組賽周日移師啟德主場館，傍晚六時另有柬埔寨對緬甸。

en.headline: Police ticket seven Tseung Kwan O youths over night bicycle offences
en.dek: Tseung Kwan O officers said the summonses follow complaints about late-night 'bullet bike' riding without lights and on pavements.

zh.headline: 將軍澳警票控7名少年 涉夜間單車無燈及踩行人路
zh.dek: 警區稱近日有區議員反映「子彈仔」深夜擾民，已向14至17歲少年發出傳票。

en.headline: Very hot weather warning reissued as Sunday highs near 33C
en.dek: The Observatory put the warning back in force at 6.45am, forecasting a fine, dry and very hot day with a yellow fire danger warning still in place.

zh.headline: 天文台再發酷熱天氣警告 市區料高見33度
zh.dek: 警告今早6時45分重新生效，預料大致天晴、乾燥及酷熱；黃色火災危險警告仍然生效。

en.headline: Po Pin Chau trail stays on quota through Sunday as hikers face full slots
en.dek: The trial booking system caps the High Island Geo Trail section at 2,000 visitors a day; Saturday crowds queued in the heat while walk-in openings remained uncertain.

zh.headline: 破邊洲周日續要預約 周六已現排隊及額滿
zh.dek: 萬宜地質步道破邊洲段試行每日2,000人次配額，中秋連假須實名預約；周六有行山人士在東壩入口等候，即場餘額並不穩定。

en.headline: Inbound rush expected at land borders this Sunday afternoon
en.dek: The Transport Department said waiting times for public transport will lengthen as mainland Mid-Autumn holiday travellers return, with extra East Rail and shuttle services running.

zh.headline: 內地中秋假期尾聲 當局料周日下午口岸入境高峰
zh.dek: 運輸署預計今日下午至晚上陸路口岸入境人流上升，過境公共交通輪候時間會較長，東鐵及金巴黃巴已加密班次。

en.headline: Man dies after suspected drowning off Sai Kung's Wong Shek Pier
en.dek: A 26-year-old was pulled unconscious from the water about 20 metres off the pier on Saturday night and later certified dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital.

zh.headline: 西貢黃石碼頭對開疑遇溺 26歲男子送院後不治
zh.dek: 途人周六晚報稱北潭路黃石碼頭對開約20米海面有人遇溺，男子昏迷送往將軍澳醫院後證實死亡。

en.headline: Anne Imhof’s House of Swans opens at Tai Kwun with ballet performances
en.dek: The German artist’s first major solo exhibition in Asia runs through 3 January, pairing new installations, paintings and sound works with live ballet staged by Hong Kong Ballet dancers.

zh.headline: 安妮．伊姆霍夫《天鵝社》大館開幕 香港芭蕾現場演出
zh.dek: 2017年威尼斯雙年展金獅獎得主首個亞洲大型個展於大館當代美術館展出至明年1月3日，結合裝置、油畫、聲音作品及香港芭蕾舞團現場演出。

en.headline: Trading card show draws collectors to AsiaWorld-Expo through Sunday
en.dek: The two-day Hong Kong Trading Card Show continues at AsiaWorld-Expo with more than 300 exhibitors offering rare Pokémon, sports and One Piece cards, live box breaks and on-site grading.

zh.headline: 香港交易卡展覽亞博續舉行 逾300攤位至周日
zh.dek: 為期兩日的香港交易卡展覽周日繼續在亞洲國際博覽館舉行，超過300個攤位展出寶可夢、運動卡及海賊王等收藏卡，並設現場開箱及評級服務。

en.headline: Mid-Autumn holiday crowds fill lantern sites on the day after the festival
en.dek: Victoria Park’s International Lantern Spectacular and other displays continued to draw families on the public holiday, with organisers managing entry to keep queues manageable.

zh.headline: 中秋翌日假期綵燈場繼續熱鬧 維園等人流管理措施維持
zh.dek: 維園世界綵燈大街及其他主要綵燈展在公眾假期繼續開放，主辦單位繼續實施人流管理，方便市民補看。

en.headline: Two Tsim Sha Tsui bar staff charged over body removal case appear in court
en.dek: A 28-year-old man and 44-year-old woman face charges including preventing the lawful burial of a corpse after a colleague was found dead on a roadside chair early on Thursday.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧棄屍案兩職員提堂 各控阻合法埋葬屍體等罪
zh.dek: 28歲男及44歲女酒吧職員被控阻止合法埋葬屍體、經營毒窟及販運危險藥物，周六在粉嶺裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Woman arrested over suspected child abuse after dashcam video circulates
en.dek: A 44-year-old was arrested in Western district on Friday after footage appeared to show a boy being shoved into a roadside railing in Wan Chai.

zh.headline: 灣仔行車記錄片段傳出後 女事主涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 一名44歲女子周五下午在西區被捕，警方指與一段疑似將男童推向路邊欄杆的行車記錄片段有關。

en.headline: Tai Po district councillor Peggy Wong resigns citing health reasons
en.dek: Wong Pik-kiu also stepped down from the Tai Po South Area Committee and as captain of a local care team; the government will gazette the vacancy.

zh.headline: 大埔區議員黃碧嬌以健康理由辭職
zh.dek: 黃碧嬌同時辭去大埔南分區委員會委員及關愛隊隊長職務，政府稍後刊憲宣布議席出缺。

en.headline: Hong Kong fencing adds two team bronzes in foil and sabre
en.dek: The women’s foil and men’s sabre teams both lost their semi-finals on Saturday and collected bronze medals under the Asian Games format that awards third place without a play-off.

zh.headline: 港隊劍擊女花男佩團體賽摘兩銅
zh.dek: 女子花劍及男子佩劍團體周六均於四強落敗，按亞運賽制無季軍賽直接獲銅牌。

en.headline: Simmi Chan takes Hong Kong’s first squash medal with Asian Games bronze
en.dek: Chan Sin-yuk fell in straight games to Malaysia’s Sivasangari Subramaniam in the women’s singles semi-final on Saturday and shares the bronze with Japan’s Satomi Watanabe.

zh.headline: 陳善鈺亞運壁球女單奪銅 港隊壁球開齋
zh.dek: 陳善鈺周六在女單四強直落三局不敵馬來西亞蘇巴拉曼尼安，與日本渡邊聡美並列銅牌。

en.headline: Hong Kong pairs set up all-SAR squash mixed doubles final
en.dek: Both Hong Kong mixed doubles combinations won their semi-finals on Saturday at the Asian Games, guaranteeing gold and silver for the city in the event.

zh.headline: 亞運壁球混雙港隊包辦決賽 鎖定金銀牌
zh.dek: 港隊兩對混雙組合周六均打入亞運決賽，確保包辦金銀牌。

en.headline: Hiker collapses on Kau Yi Chau, airlifted by helicopter
en.dek: A man in his 30s lost consciousness while hiking on the outlying island on Saturday afternoon; Government Flying Service crews lifted him to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital.

zh.headline: 西貢娥眉洲男子行山暈倒 直升機送院
zh.dek: 一名約30歲男子周六下午在娥眉洲行山期間突然不適並陷入昏迷，政府飛行服務隊直升機將他送往東區醫院治理。

en.headline: Paul Chan departs for AIIB annual meeting in Qatar
en.dek: The Financial Secretary will deliver a keynote on digital public infrastructure and meet fellow governors and business leaders under the theme of tomorrow's infrastructure.

zh.headline: 陳茂波深夜啟程赴卡塔爾出席亞投行年會
zh.dek: 財政司司長將在多哈亞投行第十一屆理事會年會發表數字公共基建主旨演講，並與其他理事及政商界領袖會面。

en.headline: Linn unveils stricter pre-approval lists for building maintenance firms
en.dek: Separate lists for survey consultants, supervision consultants and contractors open for applications from 30 September, with background checks and a de-listing mechanism to curb collusion.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪推樓宇維修預審名單 準則更嚴防打龍通
zh.dek: 發展局將為驗樓顧問、監工顧問及承建商設立三張獨立預審名單，9月30日起接受申請，目標年底備妥，明年首季協助業主招標。

en.headline: Police seize 10 cars in Clear Water Bay anti-illegal racing operation
en.dek: East Kowloon traffic officers intercepted 15 private cars on Mid-Autumn night; 10 were detained for suspected illegal modifications after intelligence indicated a planned race.

zh.headline: 中秋夜清水灣打擊非法賽車 10車疑非法改裝被扣查
zh.dek: 東九龍總區交通部中秋夜在清水灣一帶展開代號「火炬」行動，截查15輛私家車，其中10輛懷疑非法改裝被扣留。

en.headline: Linn pledges public account on Queen Mary Hospital lift defects
en.dek: Development chief Bernadette Linn said a report for the Chief Executive would detail how problems with 24 of 28 lifts in the new clinical block arose and when they were identified.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪承諾就瑪麗醫院升降機問題向公眾交代
zh.dek: 發展局局長甯漢豪表示，將向行政長官提交報告，交代新臨床大樓28部升降機中24部出現問題的原因及發現時間，報告其後會向公眾披露。
